editorial: Step right up to a neon-soaked nightmare where grief and lust collide in the most intoxicating way. You will find yourself hypnotized by the blurring lines between predatory hunger and genuine romantic longing. Justin Powell delivers a masterclass in production design, turning the carnival grounds into a claustrophobic, gold-leafed trap. If you crave horror that prioritizes atmosphere over jump scares, you cannot miss this. It is a decadent descent into darkness that lingers long after the credits roll.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of erotic horror and stylized gothic cinema.
